NOTES:
- The board lists only the viewer's own items, and moves are computed from the viewer's own tenant's workflow. A member therefore never sees the owner's item, and a member item bound to the owner's workflow has no moves. The old guard was silently skipping this check.
- I added a read-only member `v1` (viewer role). It has its own item with no workflow (legacy workflow), so the board shows `role_restricted` moves and an item-level `blocked_reason == "role_restricted"`. `_item` gained an optional `tenant=` argument.
- The first run failed with `workflow_signoff_requests` missing, so I ran `alembic upgrade head`. The tests passed after that.
- I fixed a mypy error in the signoff_required mapping test by typing `http.detail` as `Any`.
